heroTitle: Invisible to ChatGPT: why AI can't find your business
heroSub: More people ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity for recommendations than ever — and most Prairie businesses are nowhere in the answers. We dig into why that happens and what a small business can actually do about it.
title: Invisible to ChatGPT

guest.name: Max Schmeiser
guest.role: VP, Data Science — Gemini App at Google DeepMind
guest.bio: PhD economist and University of Regina alum now leading data science for the Gemini App at Google DeepMind. Previously held senior data and research roles at Netflix, Twitter, Amazon, and the US Federal Reserve.
